name: Payback
description: You strike hard in retaliation. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d8 + MOVE dark damage on a hit. If the target has dealt any damage to you since the end of your last turn, double the damage you deal.
higherLevels: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 4d4 at level 10, and 3d10 at level 17.
